tools.name: get_model_summary
tools.description: Get summary of the active Revit model: title, path, view count, wall/door/window instance counts.

tools.name: resolve_names
tools.description: Map the user's words to exact Revit names (category, level, family, type, parameter, view, sheet).

tools.name: get_wall_metrics
tools.description: Get wall quantities: count, total length (mm), total area (m²), total volume (m³).

tools.name: get_selection_summary
tools.description: Summarize current selection: count by category and type.

tools.name: get_active_view_info
tools.description: Get active view info: name, type, scale, level, visible element counts.

tools.name: get_visible_elements_in_view
tools.description: List visible elements in active view, optionally filtered by category.

tools.name: capture_view
tools.description: Take a picture of a view or of chosen elements for the model to look at.

tools.name: find_elements_by_filter
tools.description: Find elements by category and optional parameter filter.

tools.name: get_element_details
tools.description: Get detailed info for one element by ID.

tools.name: get_warnings
tools.description: Get document warnings (count + first N messages).

tools.name: get_rooms
tools.description: List rooms: number, name, level, area (m²).

tools.name: get_levels_and_grids
tools.description: List levels and grids: name, elevation (mm), Id.

tools.name: get_quantities
tools.description: Get length (mm) / area (m²) / volume (m³) for given elementIds or current selection.

tools.name: get_document_info
tools.description: Get document info: title, path, worksharing, central. Read-only.

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Save the active Revit document. L3. Host confirms before write.

tools.name: isolate_in_view
tools.description: Temporarily isolate elements or a whole category in the active view.

tools.name: hide_in_view
tools.description: Temporarily hide elements or a category in the active view.

tools.name: reset_temporary_view
tools.description: Reset (disable) temporary hide/isolate in the active view.

tools.name: override_color_in_view
tools.description: Set temporary color override for elements or a whole category.

tools.name: color_by_construction_schedule
tools.description: Bulk color elements in active view by construction schedule.

tools.name: color_by_parameter
tools.description: Color elements in the active view by any instance parameter value.

tools.name: reset_view_overrides
tools.description: Put back the active view's graphic overrides from before LoadingAI coloured it.

tools.name: set_parameter_by_id
tools.description: Set a parameter on a single element by Id.

tools.name: set_comments_on_selection
tools.description: Set the Comments parameter on the currently selected elements.

tools.name: batch_set_parameter
tools.description: Batch set a parameter on all elements matching a category+filter.

tools.name: rename_elements
tools.description: Rename views/sheets or other named elements by Id.

tools.name: apply_construction_dates
tools.description: Bulk apply Construction Date bottom-up by level elevation.

tools.name: move_elements
tools.description: Move elements by vector (mm).

tools.name: delete_elements
tools.description: Delete selected elements, or pass elementIds.

tools.name: create_wall
tools.description: Create a wall by start/end points (mm) on a level.

tools.name: create_family_instance
tools.description: Place a family instance by symbol name at a point (mm) on a level.

tools.name: duplicate_element
tools.description: Duplicate a view/sheet/element by Id.

tools.name: get_worksets
tools.description: List worksets. Compatible with worksharing models.

tools.name: get_phases
tools.description: List phases.

tools.name: get_design_options
tools.description: List design options and option sets.

tools.name: get_sheets_views
tools.description: List sheets and views counts by type.

tools.name: get_family_types
tools.description: List family symbols by category.

tools.name: get_materials
tools.description: List materials in model.

tools.name: get_room_area
tools.description: Sum room area by level.

tools.name: get_clash_by_bb
tools.description: Find clashing element pairs by bounding box overlap.

tools.name: get_model_health_score
tools.description: Overall health score: warnings, views, worksets, rooms.

tools.name: audit_issue_set
tools.description: Read-only issue check: views, sheet numbers, marks, rooms, imported CAD, in-place families, and an optional missing parameter.

tools.name: export_params_to_excel
tools.description: Export element parameters to CSV (Excel compatible).

tools.name: import_excel_to_params
tools.description: Import CSV (Excel) to set parameters by Id. Dry-run lists old and new values and writes nothing.

tools.name: copy_params
tools.description: Copy a parameter onto another for a category. Dry-run lists old and new values and writes nothing.

tools.name: replace_text
tools.description: Regex replace in a parameter. Dry-run lists old and new values and writes nothing.

tools.name: numbering_auto
tools.description: Auto number Mark by selection order or category.

tools.name: create_sheet
tools.description: Create sheet. Params: sheetNumber, sheetName, titleBlockName optional.

tools.name: place_view_on_sheet
tools.description: Place view on sheet. Params: viewId, sheetId, x,y optional.

tools.name: duplicate_view_ex
tools.description: Duplicate a view. Pick one, or leave it empty to duplicate the active view.

tools.name: set_view_template
tools.description: Apply or clear a view template by name. Empty views use the active view. Dry-run lists the change.

tools.name: set_crop_box
tools.description: Turn the crop box on or off. Empty views use the active view.

tools.name: create_dimension
tools.description: Dimension the clear distance between two parallel walls. Empty view uses the active view.

tools.name: tag_all
tools.description: Tag up to 50 elements of one category in the active view. Dry-run counts them and writes nothing.

tools.name: create_floor_by_outline
tools.description: Create floor by rectangle outline. Params: levelName, x1,y1,x2,y2 in mm.

tools.name: create_roof
tools.description: Create flat roof by outline. Params: levelName, x1,y1,x2,y2 in mm.

tools.name: create_grid_level
tools.description: Create grid and level. Params: kind grid|level, name, coordinates or elevation.

tools.name: create_family_instance_array
tools.description: Array family instances along line.

tools.name: rotate_elements
tools.description: Rotate elements around Z.

tools.name: mirror_elements
tools.description: Mirror elements across line.

tools.name: join_geometry
tools.description: Join two elements geometry.

tools.name: reload_links
tools.description: Reload all RVT links.

tools.name: workset_assign
tools.description: Assign elements to workset.

tools.name: sync_info
tools.description: Get worksharing central and sync status.

tools.name: audit_warnings_fix
tools.description: List warnings with suggested fix.

tools.name: quantity_takeoff_by_category
tools.description: Quantity takeoff by category: count, total area, volume, length aggregated to CSV.
